newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ariad upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ariad upgraded to buy.

text.p: --Vector Securities International Inc said Friday it upgraded Ariad Pharmaceuticals Inc to buy from venture, with a price target of $9.

--"In our view, Ariad will soon take steps which will unlock the hidden value in the company's rich reserve of technology," analyst Michael King Jr noted in a report. He called Ariad a leader in the field of the development of small-molecule therapeutic compounds for treating a variety of diseases with large market potential.
--Ariad, a biotech company, traded at 5-1/2, up 1/8.
